Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fullAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 5 - Full automation. The system is capable of performing its entire mission without external intervention.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packageUrl
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Package-URL (PURL), as defined in [ECMA-427](https://ecma-international.org/publications-and-standards/standards/ecma-427/).
A collection of Elements, not necessarily with unifying context.
A tuple of two positive integers that define a range.
A software agent.
EvidenceType refers to categories of documented or observable proof used to verify compliance, qualification, or performance

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: license
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional license information related to an artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evaluatedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been evaluated on the `to` Element(s).
Specifies the type of simulation model used to represent virtual hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kilowattHour
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Kilowatt-hour.
Provides a place for the SPDX data creator to record acknowledgement text for a software Package, File or Snippet.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidenceUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier used by a reporting management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify an evidence relationship item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDataFile
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element treats each `to` Element as a data file. A data file is an artifact that stores data required or optional for the `from` Element's functionality. The `hasDataFile` relationship does not imply a dependency. Examples of data files include database files, index files, log files, AI model files, calibration data files, temporary files, and backup files. For configuration data, build input data, build output data, test artifacts, test datasets, and training datasets, the more specific relationship types `configures`, `hasInput`, `hasOutput`, `hasTest`, `testedOn`, and `trainedOn` shall be used, respectively.
Product Part Number as defined by OEM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: supplyChain
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the SupplyChain profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: install
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is used to install software on disk.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dependsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element depends on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Core/Action is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: buildMeta
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the build metadata related to a published package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: publishedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was made available for public use or reference by each `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: syntactic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data describes the syntax or semantics of a language or text, such as a parse tree used for natural language processing.
A license expression participating in a license set.
Street address includes a street number, name and unit ID to identify a specific street.
A PlanAction involves the execution of a plan in relation to a PlanProcess.

A rationale is supporting information that provides the underlying justification or reasoning for an associated element, decision, or process.
A reference to a resource identifier defined outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.
Property describes the invocation entrypoint of a build.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md6
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [MD6 hash function](https://people.csail.mit.edu/rivest/pubs/RABCx08.pdf)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: follows
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` Element succeeds the `from` Element, establishing a unidirectional sequence. This succession is defined as chronological, procedural, or logical. It is used to represent either a temporal order (e.g., in a workflow) or a logical order for processing and traversal (e.g., in an ordered list).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: configuration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is configuration data.
Property describing a parameter used in an instance of a build.
Date of product release.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A point representing the mean position of the matter in a body or system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandedLicensing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the ExpandedLicensing profile specification.
Identifies who or what supplied the artifact or VulnAssessmentRelationship referenced by the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ownership
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Ownership refers to the legal right to control, manage, and benefit from an asset, resource, or responsibility. It establishes authority, accountability, and entitlements over something, whether it's property, a business, intellectual property, or responsibilities.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: low
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Low/no risk is posed by an AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rorid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Research Organization Registry (ROR) identifier](https://ror.org/about/) is a unique identifier for research and funding organization, typically expressed in its preferred URI form such as `https://ror.org/02mhbdp94`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dalA
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Design Assurance Level A for aviation software assurance.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A systematic examination of a system, process, or outcome to evaluate compliance of specific work products with a specific expectation with a specification, regulation or standard. Often involves judgement and a rationale of this judgement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: delegatedTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Agent is delegating an action to the Agent of the `to` Relationship (which shall be of type invokedBy), during a LifecycleScopeType period (e.g. the `to` invokedBy Relationship is being done on behalf of `from`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is the evidence that a specification or requirement has been fulfilled.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Business Identifier Code (BIC), also known as SWIFT-BIC or SWIFT code, is a unique 8 or 11-character alphanumeric code standardized by [ISO 9362](https://www.iso.org/standard/84108.html) to identify financial and non-financial institutions (e.g., `BBWCUS33`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iswc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Musical Work Code (ISWC)](https://www.iswc.org/iswc) is an 11-character unique identifier standardized by [ISO 15707](https://www.iso.org/standard/83125.html) for musical works (compositions) as distinct from specific recordings. While the "ISWC" label and grouping separators (dots and hyphens) are used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `T0017812031`).
Provides an SSVC assessment for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: duns
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Data Universal Numbering System (D-U-N-S) Number](https://www.dnb.com/en-us/smb/duns.html) is a unique nine-digit identifier, issued by Dun & Bradstreet, that identifies a business entity, often on a location-specific basis.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: manifest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software manifest.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verificationUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier used by a verification management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify a verification item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasTest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a test artifact for the `from` Element (`from` hasTest `to`), during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: recording
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Captured datastream like audio, video, or any other kind of continuous electronic capture of events, behavior or conditions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Serial Number (ISSN)](https://www.issn.org/understanding-the-issn/what-is-an-issn/) is an eight-digit identifier for serial publications and other continuing resources standardized by [ISO 3297](https://www.iso.org/standard/84536.html). It consists of two groups of four digits separated by a hyphen, where the final character is a check digit that may be an "X". The hyphen is retained when the identifier is stored electronically to maintain the standard 9-character string format (e.g., `1464-3693`). The ISSN is media-specific; the same journal title may be assigned different identifiers for its physical and digital versions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: binaryArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to binary artifacts related to a package.
Describes the type of annotation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: affects
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability, Action or DefinedProcess affects each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: high
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 7.0 - 8.9.

Expression for the export control classification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: data

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: altWebPage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an alternative web page.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasConcludedLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact is concluded by the SPDX data creator to be governed by each `to` /SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo. If the `to` of an Artifact's `hasConcludedLicense` is not the same as the `to` of its `hasDeclaredLicense`, a written explanation should be provided in the comment field of the `hasConcludedLicense` relationship.
A collection of SPDX Elements that could potentially be serialized.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a bill of materials.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: webpage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that can be used to locate a resource, as defined in [RFC 9110](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9110/) Section 4.2.1 or Section 4.2.2. It may include an optional fragment identifier as specified in [RFC 3986](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3986) Section 3.5.
Abstract class representing a license combination consisting of one or more licenses.
A map of Element identifiers that are used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.
The element that has its responsibility changed.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ibrn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Registration Number (IBRN)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a unique identifier for legal entities standardized by [ISO 8000-116](https://www.iso.org/standard/75117.html). It is composed of two parts: a jurisdiction prefix and a local authoritative legal entity identifier (ALEI), separated by a colon. The prefix contains an ISO 3166 country code, an optional subdivision code, and a register code (e.g., `US-DE.BER:3031657`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: active
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement has been approved by stakeholder, and can be include in traceability.
A specification type defines the nature of a specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssociatedVulnerability
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to associate a `from` Artifact with each `to` /Security/Vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isrc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Recording Code (ISRC)](https://isrc.ifpi.org/isrc-standard) is a unique 12-character alphanumeric identifier for sound recordings and music video recordings standardized by [ISO 3901](https://www.iso.org/standard/64817.html). While the "ISRC" label and grouping hyphens used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `USCA28900153`).
Provides the location for more information regarding an external identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: partialAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 2 - Partial automation or task automation. Some sub-functions of the system are fully automated while the system remain under control of an external agent. The system can perform actions for an approved task without requiring the agent's continuous direct control.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cwe
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Weakness Enumeration](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/common_weakness_enumeration). A reference to a source of software flaws defined within the official [CWE List](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/) that conforms to the [CWE specification](https://cwe.mitre.org/).
Maps a "LicenseRef-" string for a custom license or a "AdditionRef-" string for a custom license addition to a `CustomLicense`, a `CustomLicenseAddition`, or a `SimpleLicensingText`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseHistory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published list of releases for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bower
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timeseries
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded in an ordered sequence of timestamped entries, such as the price of a stock over the course of a day.
Identifies from where or whom the Element originally came.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other units of energy measurement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: glue
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [GLobal Unique Enterprise (GLUE) Identifiers](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-spice-glue-id/), as defined by the IETF Internet-Draft, is expressed as a GLUE URI, a Uniform Resource Identifier that standardizes the representation of existing organizational entity identifiers.
Information related to hardware dimension.
Methods that can be used to explain the results from the AI model.
Provides the result of an export control assessment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gtin
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Global Trade Item Number (GTIN)](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gtin) is a number, assigned by GS1, that uniquely identifies a trade item (product or service).
An entity providing an assessment.
Type of the model used in the AI software.
Sets the context for an assessment by specifying the related project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: backlog
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement has been captured and logged, but not yet ready to become a formal requirement draft. A backlog requirement may still be incomplete or ambiguous.
Refers to any unit of content that can be associated with a distribution of software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: graph
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is in the form of a graph where entries are somehow related to each other through edges, such as a social network of friends.
A location where a package or an item will be dropped off or delivered.
The percentile of the current probability score.
Provides a License author's preferred text to indicate that a file is covered by the License.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: act
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level and leadership-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, as well as publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. Typically, internal groups would meet to determine the overall response and then execute agreed upon actions. CISA recommends remediating Act vulnerabilities as soon as possible.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: exportControlAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an export control assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specification is a detailed document (or set of documents) that describes the requirements, design, behavior, or other characteristics of a system, component, or process so that all stakeholders have a clear, unambiguous reference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vcs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a version control system related to a software artifact.
A license or a license addition that is not listed on the SPDX License List.
Connects a vulnerability and an element designating the element as a product affected by the vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clear
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Unlimited. Subject to standard copyright rules, the dataset may be shared freely, without restriction.
ISO level of automation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: underInvestigationFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability impact is being investigated for each `to` Element. The use of the `underInvestigationFor` type is constrained to `/Security/VexUnderInvestigationVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.
A reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content related to an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: application
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software application.
A LicenseAddition participating in a 'with addition' model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The third-highest level of risk posed by an AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability has been fixed by the `to` Agent(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: validatedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been validated on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element doesn't fit into any of the other categories.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: symlink
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This file represents a symbolic link (soft link).
Authorization specifies the permissions, rights, privileges, or benefits granted to a Role, defining what the role is authorized to access, perform, or receive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssessmentFor

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityOther

Owner or lead of the project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: device
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element refers to a chipset, processor, or electronic board.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: documentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the documentation for a package.

Preprocessing steps that were applied to the raw data to create the given dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: notAutomated
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 0 - Not automated. No automation. The operator fully controls the system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: trackStar
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: ("Track\*" in the SSVC spec) The vulnerability contains specific characteristics that may require closer monitoring for changes. CISA recommends remediating Track\* vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audit
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An examination typically focusing on compliance with policies, standards, or regulations. Usually this is done during an audit meeting, while the assessment also involves deep and detailed reviews of work products (e.g. requirements, verification specifications, reports etc.)

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Core/Location is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: limitedSupport

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other relevant type of proof or documentation not covered above.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pretrainedOn

Specifies the exploit catalog type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 256, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.
Contains a URL where the License or LicenseAddition can be found in use.
How the dataset was collected.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: software
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Software profile specification.
Describes if any sensitive personal information is present in the dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: serious
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The highest level of risk posed by an AI system.
Provides an unambiguous mechanism for conveying a URI fragment portion of an Element ID.
Metric used to evaluate the AI model.
A prescribed change to a product.
References the Element on the left-hand side of a relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: executable
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an Artifact that can be run on a computer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: operatingSystem

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityOther

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: highAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 4 - High automation. The system performs parts of its mission without external intervention.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseNotes

Provides the license under which the SPDX documentation of the Element can be used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: x509Cert
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an X.509 certificate as defined in [RFC 5280](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc5280/). The primary media type shall be `application/pkix-cert`. NOTE — RFC 5280 supersedes earlier X.509 profiles, including RFC 1422. Existing references based on RFC 1422 remain valid.
AssemblyAction represents the event of creating a product by assembling individual components.
A statement of how, or for what purpose, an item or artifact is intended to be used.
A class for describing the energy consumption incurred by an AI model in different stages of its lifecycle.
A license addition that is not listed on the SPDX Exceptions List.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: source
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a single or a collection of source files.

Evaluation is an outcome considering results of a verification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: chat

referenceSpecification provides a reference to a DefinedType that defines the specific meaning, structure, and semantics of a Role. It connects the role to its authoritative source definition, ensuring consistent interpretation across different contexts.
Provides a numerical (0-10) representation of the severity of a vulnerability.
Specifies an Element where a vulnerability was found.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: megajoule
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Megajoule.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deviceDriver
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element represents software that controls hardware devices.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: email
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Email address, as defined in [RFC 3696](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3696/) Section 3.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packagedBy

Describes if a given file is a directory or non-directory kind of file.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reportedBy

Indicates the specific RequirementVerification instance on which the EvaluationResult is based.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: text
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists of unstructured text, such as a book, a Wikipedia article (without images), or a transcript.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a plan, guideline or strategy how to create, perform or analyze an application.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md5
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD5 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1321](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1321/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inspection
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A thorough examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence. An inspection needs to have a defined set of acceptance criteria (e.g. a checklist), a documentation of roles involved in the inspection (e.g. to document the inspector's independence) and a clear documentation of when and how it was performed.
Specifies whether the License is listed as approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).

Quantity is the amount in the selected QUDT unit.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOptionalComponent

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: No assertion about the type of support is made. This is considered the default if no other support type is used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: autonomous
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 6 - Autonomous. The system is capable of modifying its intended domain of use or its goals without external intervention, control or oversight.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isci
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: International Standard Collection Identifier (ISCI) is a variable-length identifier standardized by [ISO 27730](https://www.iso.org/standard/44293.html) for identifying collections held by libraries, archives, museums, and other memory institutions. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).
